tools.name: perfectview_search_relations
tools.description: Search the relations (customers, leads and companies) in the PerfectView database by name, one page at a time. Use it to find the relation_id that other tools need. SOAP: RelationSearchByName_V2.

tools.name: perfectview_get_relation
tools.description: Get one relation by its GUID, optionally with its custom field values and counters. SOAP: RelationGet.

tools.name: perfectview_get_relation_notes
tools.description: List the notes written on one relation. SOAP: RelationGetNotes.

tools.name: perfectview_add_relation_note
tools.description: Write a new note on one relation in PerfectView. It is saved at once and cannot be undone through this tool. SOAP: RelationAddNote.

tools.name: perfectview_search_relationships
tools.description: Search the relationships (links between a person and an organisation, such as an employee or contact) by name, one page at a time. SOAP: RelationshipSearchByName_V2.

tools.name: perfectview_get_relationship
tools.description: Get one relationship by its GUID, optionally with its custom field values. SOAP: RelationshipGet.

tools.name: perfectview_get_activity
tools.description: Get one activity (a task, call, meeting or other registered action) by its GUID. SOAP: ActivityGet.

tools.name: perfectview_list_products
tools.description: List the products and services defined in the PerfectView database. SOAP: ProductGetAll_V2.

tools.name: perfectview_get_relation_fields
tools.description: List the field definitions (names and types) for one kind of relation. Use it before reading custom fields. SOAP: RelationGetFields.
